claims: The San Antonio Spurs have a 59-19 record.
The San Antonio Spurs are playing at home against the Philadelphia 76ers on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. ET.
The game will be held at the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, TX.
Televised coverage of the game is available on FDSN-Southwest and NBCS-Philadelphia.
The San Antonio Spurs lost to the Nuggets 136-134 in overtime on April 4th.
Victor Wembanyama scored 34 points in the Spurs' game against the Nuggets on April 4th.
The San Antonio Spurs have clinched a playoff berth
